baremacion.ayuda_meritos: An item in the merit record can be used to check an entry requirement and, separately, to score a merit. The score belongs to one application and to a specific version of the terms.
baremacion.ayuda_ranking: A simulation is a guide during preparation. The submitted self-assessment, the provisional scoring and the final scoring are different results. The final list only establishes a job pool after the relevant closure and signature.
baremacion.ayuda_alegaciones: An appeal, its review and its decision are separate steps. Correcting a decision requires access, a reason and supporting documents. The earlier decision remains in the history.
baremacion.tabla_desplazar: Scroll the table to see the other columns.
baremacion.meritos_descripcion: View declared data, check access and score by call for applications.

baremacion.meritos_rectificacion: To correct a decision, you need access, a reason and supporting documents. The previous decision remains in the history.
baremacion.baremacion_descripcion: View the score linked to the terms and the application; this screen does not calculate or publish.
baremacion.baremacion_aviso: This view does not replace the versioned calculation or the administrative publication.

baremacion.alegaciones_bloqueada: The decision and notification are not connected; a document, deadline, competent authority and signature are required.
baremacion.alegaciones_rectificacion: If an objection affects the scoring, a versioned recalculation and a new publication are needed where applicable.

contratos.descripcion: View people’s employment relationships and availability. To confirm a termination or start of work, open the relevant procedure.

contratos.detalle_denegado: The current profile does not have permission to view these relationships.

contratos.paso_bolsa_descripcion: The call proposal remains pending until acceptance is confirmed.
contratos.paso_formalizacion: Formalisation and signature · Temporary staff requests
contratos.paso_formalizacion_descripcion: The draft and authentication are not a signature.
contratos.paso_personal: Relationship and start of work · Personnel
contratos.paso_personal_descripcion: Only Personnel confirms the relationship and the start of work.
contratos.paso_ginpix: Delivery to GINPIX · Temporary staff requests
contratos.paso_ginpix_descripcion: Downloading the form does not send it to GINPIX.
contratos.paso_reincorporacion: Termination and availability · Personnel and Job pools
contratos.paso_reincorporacion_descripcion: The proven termination comes before the job pool policy.
contratos.descripcion_ceses: A termination requires a fact confirmed by Personnel. Viewing relationships does not replace its receipt.
contratos.descripcion_reincorporacion: Job pools determines availability after receiving the proven termination and applying its current policy.
contratos.registros_subtitulo: Employment relationships available in this view.
contratos.vacio: There are no relationships to show.
contratos.motivo_contrato: The employment relationship has not yet been confirmed in Personnel. Check the case before continuing.
contratos.motivo_cese: A termination proven by Personnel and its receipt are missing.
contratos.motivo_reincorporar: The proven termination and the versioned job pool policy are missing.
contratos.ayuda_contenido: Temporary staff requests coordinates references; Job pools keeps proposals, acceptances, order and availability. Personnel keeps relationships and starts of work. The signature and delivery to GINPIX require their own receipts. After a termination, Job pools applies the current policy to the person, without inferring availability from this screen.
